title: A coordinator's lane start asks when an open roadmap step already covers the same ruling or topic, and names it
why: Coordinator 12:18 CST Nov 8, its own mistake: it started lane builder-diff-vs-merged-main (session_013NEJL3tzwg72Zt2vUzJUey) for item 437 a, a duplicate of step builder-diff-merge-commit (lane session_013NEJKzVTWMbokJ3KFanBBC); archived at a cost of $0.50, no commits. Fix: create_session for a lane refuses or asks when an open step covers the same ruling or topic, and names that step.
note: Coordinator 12:22 CST Nov 8, second lane-start mistake: a lane for lanes-sonnet-trial was started with no source_url, so it had no repo (archived, $0.29, nothing written). Same guard: a create_session tagged cs-build:lane with no source_url refuses.
